appearance.identity: Seven warm stone/glass towers, pale roof tents and a taller offset clock tower with four dials, green crown and gold crescent.
appearance.exclusions: Interiors, underground works and neighboring city blocks.

brief: Compact Abraj complex retains the mapped podium and six surrounding towers, cardinally aligned offset clock tower, four dials, V supports, glass jewel, gold spire and solid crescent. Original detailed master remains reproducible; browser levels simplify repeated facades and ornaments.

sourceFacts.reviewScope: Original260178-triangle25398552-byte source reproduced exactly; detailed original recipe preserved. Independent browser derivatives retain the distinguishing exterior with tiered detail.

geographic.notes: Inspected a contractor clock-construction photograph and a completed lower-tower/tent photograph. They establish the large gold-edged dial, warm ribbed hotel facades and pale tensioned roof tents; they do not certify the completed crescent or exact whole-complex crown. Preserve original601m source height,23m crescent and existing mapped seven-tower/podium layout. Main clock shaft remains separately offset at[39.82553895,21.41812445] and internally aligned cardinally; six named lower parts retain their plans and authored heights. Standard viewer PMTiles confirms the Great Mosque/complex context. Off-podium PMTiles point[0,140]328.125m sets approximate ground contact; center333.3364m and nearby hills are coarse. Rectangular preview contact correction covers the complex, with raw terrain kept separately. Exact tent sag, clock typography, calligraphy, mosaic ornament, entrances and thresholds remain approximate or omitted. Existing601/607m datum disagreement remains documented; no new survey is claimed.
